comments.author: os
comments.text:
As a scanner user, I want Ruby topology findings grounded in concrete infrastructure and framework evidence, so that Rails applications produce useful components without model, concern, controller, or ordinary service false positives.

Feature: Ruby detector topology
  Scenario: Scan Ruby and Rails source
    Given Ruby source containing Rails routes, authentication integrations, database configuration, or external HTTP clients
    When the Ruby analyzer detects topology
    Then it emits grouped API, concrete authentication, database, cache, and external API evidence
    And it does not emit ActiveRecord models, controllers, concerns, or ordinary service classes as components
    And root-relative excluded paths are ignored
